card.name: Linked-to or implicated in a condition
card.fires_on: The word right after "has been" such as implicated or associated, and "role" after "important", when a factor is said to be linked to a disease or effect.

modes.label: Has been implicated/associated
modes.description: Participle after "has/have been" that states a possible link between a drug or factor and an outcome.
modes.example: Excessive beta-adrenergic stimulation has been<< associated>> with seizures, angina, hypertension or

modes.label: Important role
modes.description: The word role after "important" when a process is said to contribute to disease or biology.
